metadata.description: S. Burns Weston, State Administrator of the National Youth Administration for Ohio, sends College Aid Letter #4 to presidents of Ohio colleges and universities. The letter requests information about institutional participation in the NYA College and Graduate Aid Program, including enrollment, Negro student enrollment, applications, approved aid, and work assigned to approved Negro applicants, and asks for reports before November 17, 1939.
metadata.title: College aid letter #4, 8 November 1939
metadata.transcript:
[page 1]
November 8, 1939

[underlined: COLLEGE AID LETTER #4]

TO: Presidents of Ohio Colleges and Universities

The Washington office of the National Youth Administration has requested a report on institution participation in the NYA [National Youth Administration] College and Graduate Aid Program, including the following information:

1. The institution's total enrollment as of November 1, 1939. 2. The number of Negro students enrolled. 3. The total number of NYA applications received. 4. The number of applications which the institution has approved or is planning to approve for NYA Aid. 5. Institutions which have approved Negro applicants are requested to indicate the type of work to which they have been assigned.

Will you, therefore, kindly furnish us with this information, and as soon as possible, on the enclosed form? We shall appreciate receiving your report [underlined: before November 17, 1939.]

Sincerely yours,

S. Burns Weston
State Administrator

BY: [handwritten] Harry E. Rabe

Harry E. Rabe, Assistant Director
Work Projects Division
